steps.name: Epilogue ~ Covering the Black Moon
steps.objective: [Irfan] from “Elysia 2” has a guest. Check the conversation with the guest and complete the quest to [Irfan].

lines.text: (Irrfan looks blankly at the sky of Elysia and then turns his gaze to the guest who came to visit him.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Elysia, which has not had any customers for a long time, is so crowded... . I have no idea how many people came before Hecate was imprisoned.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's also amazing that Hecate created a place of trial for him and invited gods from other worlds.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Is that so? Now, eat it.
(Daphne gives tea made from the leaves of the plant to Irfan.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Ah, this is the scent of Eastland. It reminds me of a time when I spent time soaking in the Azuna hot springs... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Based on my memories of my lifetime, I should be thankful to Hecate just for being able to enjoy tea... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Was this the third time we had tea like this?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I was truly grateful when you saved my clan's child. It was a time when the only thing I could serve was tea. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That car was good at the time. Does that still bother you? I also received help, so you don't have to take that to heart.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now let’s get to the point. Because I know that you came to Elysia to avoid the eyes of Hecate.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you came this far using enough power to obscure the Black Moon, it must be important to you too.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I hope you can help me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I have already paid what I owe you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I need you to help me just this once.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So what do I get?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will give you a new life.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You speak like Agashura.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Agashura loses himself by contract, but I do not.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Please ask again. I will give you a complete life, not an imperfect life tied to Elysia.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How can you believe that?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: We'll show you in the upcoming night.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I will help you, but I don't need any compensation. Because I am satisfied with my life here. Instead, help Hecate when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Think about it then. Now, let's listen. What is that request?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I would like you to open the Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What did you say just now?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How do you know about Atlas Garden?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I thought that Irrfan, who is close to a deity, would be able to open the garden wide, and I guess I was right. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So what are you going to do there?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will welcome the child who chases the night again for a different cause. This is helpful to Hecate... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand. Follow me. But, this kid… . Did you bring it here?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Hello, hello☆

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes, that's right. He's the one who will help me. It will probably be more helpful than a child who just ran away.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Daphne, Daphne. That garden over there is an interesting place, isn’t it?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of course. Circe will have a new friend.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Because what that friend wants is a smile and love. Hehe… .
